rule.name: NullMapValue
rule.message: This map collector throws NullPointerException when the value function of toMap, toUnmodifiableMap or toConcurrentMap, or the classifier of groupingBy, returns null, which a Map.Entry::getValue over Object, wildcard or @Nullable values, a @Nullable method, Map.get, orElse(null) and a null branch can. Filter the nulls first (filter(e -> e.getValue() != null)), map them (Objects.toString, Optional), or collect into a HashMap with collect(HashMap::new, (m, e) -> m.put(k, v), Map::putAll) when nulls are meant to be kept. An exception fits only for a value that is never null but not declared so.
